name: building-with-decision-models
description: Unofficial Codex skill for building with decision models (System One models) such as TypeSafe Jev, Cloudflare Clef, Perplexity pplx-decider, Databricks ai_decide, and local Ollama models: typed Choice/Score/Noul decisions, calibrated-confidence routing, provider differences, and community prior art sorted by implementation shape.

interface.shortDescription: Typed decisions with calibrated confidence, on any provider
interface.longDescription: Write correct decision-model integrations on Jev, Clef, pplx-decider, Databricks ai_decide, or a local Ollama model: pick Choice, Score, or Noul; batch speculative questions in one call; route on confidence; handle provider differences and re-tune thresholds when models change; and find prior art, each pattern with a code sketch, before designing something new.
defaultPrompt: Use building-with-decision-models to replace this LLM classification call with a decision model.
Find prior art for a decision-model design before we build it.
Help me move this Jev integration to another provider without breaking its thresholds.
